Web lead NRC EA/FONSI for Radiant R-50 (docket 70-7045): not found. The WNN 2026-11-24 article 'Key step in licensing of US TRISO fuel facilities' is about Standard Nuclear's SN-TN and SN-ID Documented Safety Analyses submitted to DOE on 2026-11-06 and 2026-11-12 (both before the window), not an R-50 EA or FONSI. NRC search results show R-50 as an EA in progress (June 2026 consultation letter) and an NRC-accepted Part 70 fueling-building application under expedited review with a targeted completion of 2026-12-18. No issued licence or FONSI found.

Web lead Nuclea Energy / Moltex acquisition: not filed. Search results show a definitive agreement announced around 2026-08-13, with completion subject to UK National Security and Investment Act approval; no completion date found. Nuclea SEC filings describe the deal as not yet completed.

Web lead NANO Nuclear KRONOS CNSC licence to prepare site: no dated submission found. Search results show plans to submit an LTPS through True North Nuclear (announced October 2025) with no filing date. Not filed.

NANO ZEUS core-block hardware release: fetched page is dated 2025-03-25, out of window. A 2026-11-11 NANO release on the Q4 business update webcast (2026-11-30) and joining WNA/IDEA is corporate, not a vendor milestone.
Deployable Energy Unity: criticality 2026-06-30 and DOME full-power selection (INL release 2026-09-30; company release 2026-10-07) are both before the window. No November 2026 news found.

Last Energy: NRC filing dated 2026-10-20 for the first part of a two-part phased construction permit application (Caldwell County, TX per Federal Register notice; the same notice's Haskell County reference was not reconciled). Already in skip/news.json (last-energy-caldwell-lwa-application-2026-10-20). No November milestone found.
Aalo Atomics: latest coverage found is March 2026 (Aalo-X completion expected end of 2026). Shipped aalo-x row is in recently-checked.md and was not re-checked.

Valar Atomics: Utah Trust Lands Administration Board approval of more than 640 acres on 2026-09-17 is supported by East Idaho News 2026-10-01 (fetched). The 480-acre state-land application reported by the Salt Lake Tribune in October is a different figure and was not reconciled. Nvidia 30 MW data center described in July 2026 coverage (KSL, Reuters via WHBL 2026-07-01) as a proposal and exploratory stage, not a built plant. No check filed. BLM completeness review pending per the Oct 1 article.

Natura Resources: 2026-11-02 Texas A&M-led DOE $5.4M award (already covered in skip/news.json as texas-am-natura-doe-fuel-recycling-grant-2026-10-29 dated 2026-10-29) and September 2026 DOE salt shipment are before the window. No November vendor milestone found.

Terra Innovatum SOLO: no November 2026 news found; latest NRC pre-application item is a January 2026 regulatory engagement plan revision. An NRC page carries an undated lapse-in-appropriations alert, not verified as current.
Steady Energy (LOKI): no 2026 coverage found. Search results returned NANO Nuclear's LOKI MMR only (RFI January 2026).
Blue Energy: 2026 coverage concerns a BWRX-300 SMR (Limited Work Authorization application dated 2026-09-15) and a Victoria, TX gas-plus-nuclear plan; not a 1-20 MWe microreactor. Out of lane.

Antares: DOE Nuclear Safety Design Agreement approval for Mark-1 announced 2026-10-23 and ANS 'Antares, Last Energy, and Radiant hit DOE authorization milestones' dated 2026-11-02 are before the window. Shipped antares row (2028 or earlier delivery, JBSA and Janus Fort Bragg) not contradicted by any source found.
Radiant: DOME Readiness Review is still pending with no date published (search results, undated). Shipped radiant row says 'Readiness Review next', which is consistent. Not filed.

BWXT BANR (Fort Campbell): Army/BWXT announcements of 2026-08-26 and a late-2028 groundbreaking target with early-2030s operation are consistent with the shipped bwxt-banr row. No dated change found. Not filed.
